## Purpose

This file is the **static catalog** of every operator-tunable lever in the DawnTrader V3 active server-side codebase. It answers: *"what's tunable, where does it live in source, how should it be scoped in `module_constants`?"*

For the live current values, see `CURRENT_SETTINGS_REGISTRY.md`.

## Classification key

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **PROMOTE** | Operator-tunable lever influencing trading decisions (gating / scoring / sizing / exit / cadence). Migrating to `module_constants` in B72. |
| **KEEP** | Pure-infra (cache TTLs, poll intervals, queue sizes, retry counts, network plumbing), schema/structural literals (100 percent, 1000 ms→s, 60 s→min, array indices, regex group counts), canonical math constants (π, e, ATR Wilder 14-period definitional), log/observability strings. Stays hardcoded. |
| **ALREADY_MIGRATED** | Already a `moduleConstantsService.get(...)` call. Recorded for inventory completeness; no action. |
| **DB_GOVERNED_ELSEWHERE** | Pulled from `screener_filters` or another canonical config table. Recorded; not double-migrated. |

**PROMOTE test:** *"would changing this value change which trades we enter, exit, or size?"* Yes → PROMOTE; No → KEEP.

**Resolution scope default:** GLOBAL `(*, *, *, *)` unless documented per-dimension calibration intent (per Langston cc-inbox #903).

**Migration risk:** LOW (pure-replacement single callsite) / MEDIUM (hot-path multi-callsite) / HIGH (regime-frozen code, tight coupling, recently stabilized).

### §3.3 Lever schema (uniform across strategies)

Every strategy file follows the same constant-block pattern at the top, exporting a struct of `<STRATEGY>_<NAME>` constants. PROMOTE rows fall into 5 archetypes (per-strategy):

| Archetype | Examples | Module bucket | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| Entry-gate thresholds | DBS_MIN, MIN_INVERSIONS, RSI_MIN, MAX_DISTANCE, MAX_CORRELATION, MIN_STRENGTH | `strategy_entry_gates` | `(*, *, <strategy>, *)` |
| Volume gates | VOL_MULT, VE_BREAKOUT_VOL_MULT, etc. | `strategy_volume_gates` | `(*, *, <strategy>, *)` |
| Indicator windows / lookbacks | LOOKBACK, LOOKBACK_CANDLES, CORR_WINDOW, VOL_WINDOW | `strategy_indicators` | `(*, *, <strategy>, *)` |
| Geometry (stop / target ATR mults, measured-move ratios) | STOP_ATR_MULT, TARGET_ATR_MULT, MEASURED_MOVE_MULT | `strategy_geometry` | `(*, *, <strategy>, *)` |
| Confidence weights / floors / ceilings / per-component bonuses | BASE_CONFIDENCE, MAX_CONFIDENCE, PATTERN_WEIGHT, RSI_WEIGHT, *_BONUS | `strategy_confidence` | `(*, *, <strategy>, *)` |
